invariants.description: a capacitor: Cm (V - V0) = I_in t with no channels (relative 1e-9); A_mem = 2 pi R h, Vol = pi R^2 h (exact)
invariants.expr: np.allclose(Cm*(V - V[0]), 1e6*I_in*t, rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-12) and np.allclose(A_mem, 2*np.pi*R_cell*h_cell, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(Vol, np.pi*R_cell**2*h_cell*1e-18, rtol=1e-12, atol=0)
